=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7561 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram alert message construction still redirects both stdout and stderr to /dev/null via `>/dev/null 2>&1`, which hides tg_send_msg's "::warning::Telegram send failed" diagnostics on curl/network errors.
  WHY: When tg_send_msg fails (e.g., due to network issues or API rate limits), the error message is suppressed, preventing operators from knowing why the alert wasn't delivered.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:14995 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The test's docstring still claims "an ALERT_MSG_LEVEL threshold above DEBUG cannot suppress this alert", which overstates the guarantee since ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT suppresses all helper-based sends.
  WHY: The test gives false confidence that the alert will always be delivered regardless of configuration, when in fact ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT can suppress it.
- changelog.d/3869-final-merge-telegram-alert.md:4 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The changelog claims the CRITICAL alert is delivered regardless of the configured ALERT_MSG_LEVEL threshold, but ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT suppresses all helper-based sends.
  WHY: Operators may believe they can fully silence Telegram when they cannot (only SILENT does that), leading to confusion when alerts are missing despite configuration.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- Requirement: "whenever the final integration PR ... is squash-merged into the default branch, `tg_send_msg` fires at **CRITICAL** level" (PR Description, `## What` section).
  Expected change site: `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed` in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
  Evidence of absence: the function has two out-of-band merged-detection paths that pin the state to merged without the new alert: (a) the recorded-final-PR closed+merged early-exit at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7382-7419` (sends neither the alert nor the `## ✅ Final merge complete` comment), and (b) the post-attempt discovery path at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7566-7579` (`pr_state=closed && pr_merged=true`, also alert-less). A manual merge or an out-of-band auto-merge (e.g. review workflow) of the final PR routes the completion through one of these paths, so the operator receives no CRITICAL Telegram signal for that merge — narrowing the stated guarantee. Note this mirrors the pre-existing convention (those paths never posted the tracking comment either), so I rate it NIT rather than MAJOR; the editor may reasonably accept the narrower scope or extend the send.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
